interpretation.protobuf: binding_file, binding_sha256, facts_files and global approved_prefix are reserved names; strict protojson loader rejects them
interpretation.scope: base_model_storage_scope retains only shared connection/bucket/credential reference; per-tenant approved prefix derives from current resource tenant; no global tenant prefix
interpretation.facts: business admission calls ReadReadyBinding from authoritative environment repository; no startup facts file loader
interpretation.sts: issuer derives session scope from persisted immutable execution; no tenant allowlist array
interpretation.webhook: Config has no bindings list; NamespaceBinding is an internal per-request dynamic readback result, not static config or tenant array
interpretation.resource: ani-modeldev-service explicitly rejects old namespaces/ownerLabels/requireTenantLabel allowlist; fixed cluster and standard tenant name+original UID must match; Sandbox namespace code belongs to another owner and is out of this change
interpretation.v3: only execution spec parser v3 is retired; separate unchanged v3 intent/output/publication formats are current contracts, not compatibility readers
